status_detail: Local social posts in late July 2026 report a Brunswick County rezoning application for construction of a data center in Freeman; county/IDA materials independently show Brunswick is actively marketing for data center and IT development, but I did not find the actual rezoning packet on the county site during this pass.
notes: Official September 2025 board packet says Brunswick County hosted VEDP/VGR representatives for a data center tour in the Brunswick County IT Industrial Park and discussed continued marketing as a premier location for data center and IT development. Treat the Freeman project as low-confidence until the rezoning case file is located.

Checked county/tourism/economic-development search results, local news, and regional Southwest Virginia data-center marketing material. Buchanan County is cited as part of regional efforts to attract data centers and Southern Gap is mentioned as a possible small data-center site, but I found no named developer, filed county permit/rezoning, purchase agreement, approval, or project announcement specific to Buchanan County.

Checked county/meeting search results and local coverage. Buckingham appears in Valley Link/Joshua Falls-Yeat transmission-line debate tied to regional data-center demand and speculative future load, but I found no named data center developer, filed rezoning, permit, approval, or project announcement inside Buckingham County.

Checked city site/local search and regional telecom results. RANA markets a colocation/data center facility in nearby Lexington serving Lexington, Buena Vista and Rockbridge County, and Munters formerly operated in Buena Vista before relocating its data-center cooling manufacturing business to Botetourt County; I found no data center campus, rezoning, permit, or project announcement in Buena Vista city itself.

project_name: MESH Capital Cabin Field Road data center
status_detail: MESH requested rezoning/proffer changes for roughly 57.42 acres at Richmond Highway and Cabin Field Road to construct a data center; the Board denied the October 7, 2025 rezoning request, but county's Cabin Field Road facts page says MESH later submitted three concept plans that staff/legal review determined generally comply with the 2000 proffered plan. January 2026 minutes indicate pending data center projects had vested rights despite new SUP requirements.
notes: Official agenda says the concept plan showed three buildings totaling 450,000 square feet. Status is not 'approved' because formal site plan approval was expressly not granted; it is also not fully 'rejected' because the by-right/proffer compliance path appears to remain active.

project_name: Mount Athos Road data center concept
aliases: Campbell County second data center project
status_detail: County Project Evaluation Committee reviewed two concept plans for a potential Mount Athos Road data center complex on a 64-acre Heavy-Industrial-zoned site; WDBJ reported 40 MW available and no official site plan submitted. Campbell County's facts page confirms a February 2024 initial concept plan and says the Mount Athos sign is unrelated to the Cabin Field Road project.
notes: WDBJ says concept alternatives include either seven large buildings or two phases totaling seven plus six-to-eight smaller buildings over about 15 years; county says it has no further information beyond the initial concept plan.

status_detail: CleanArc announced groundbreaking of its flagship Caroline County campus on Nov. 20, 2025, with 900 MW of grid capacity: first 300 MW expected online in Q1 2027, second 300 MW projected for 2030, and another 300 MW in 2033-2035.
notes: Company press release describes roughly 1 GW grid power and approximately $13 million in new annual county tax revenue.

status_detail: U.S. Army Corps public notice for NAO-2024-01108 lists Amazon Data Services as applicant for the Mattameade Data Center located southeast of I-95 and Mudd Tavern Road in Spotsylvania and Caroline counties; proposed work includes 11 two-story data center buildings on an approximately 1,143-acre 13-parcel area, plus administration building, substations, water/wastewater facilities, roads and security infrastructure.
notes: Project straddles Caroline and Spotsylvania counties; included for Caroline because the federal notice explicitly names both counties.

status_detail: Caroline County Planning Commission materials for RZ-03-2023 describe ADP Carmel Church Data Hub LLC's request to amend existing Carmel Church Station proffers for a phased data center project on approximately 97 acres. DCD reports Avaio's Carmel Church Data Hub in Ruther Glen is a 100-acre build-to-suit/wholesale campus expected to deliver more than 300 MW, with an initial 130 MW phase projected for H1 2026.
notes: Capacity comes from DCD/Avaio reporting; county records confirm project/proffer action but not MW.

notes: DCD says Avaio lists a planned Ladysmith-area Caroline project and a county site plan suggests two buildings, but detailed MW has not been shared.

status_detail: Caroline County current rezoning page lists Case RZ-03-2025 by Thornberry, LLC to rezone 657 acres of a 1,001.5-acre parcel at 23202 Carneal Lane to Planned Innovation Research & Technology district for a data center campus; county page says submittal is complete and forwarded for review with no hearing date determined.
notes: No MW or building count found in the quick pass.

status_detail: Caroline County current rezoning page lists Case RZ-04-2024 for NRD Retail, LLC/Mid Atlantic State Fund to rezone property on Bull Church Road east of I-95 near the Ladysmith interchange from Rural Preservation to M-1 Industrial for a data center and supporting uses; application was in technical review with no hearing date determined. status_detail: Caroline County lists Case RZ-06-2024 to rezone 1,196.3 acres off Jericho Road/Rogers Clark Boulevard/U.S. Route 1 from Rural Preservation to M-1 Industrial; trackers and community debate associate the site with possible data center development, but July 2026 local reporting quotes the applicant as saying 'It's not going to be data centers.'

Checked county official pages, tax rates, EDA pages, and local/social search. Carroll County has adopted a data center personal property tax class for equipment over $1 million and local discussion groups are debating whether to regulate or oppose data centers, but I found no named developer, permit, rezoning, approval, or project announcement in Carroll County, Virginia.

status_detail: County documents show PointOne data center site-plan review through 2026, and a DEQ/SPGP verification letter for PointOne Richmond Data Center says the project may proceed as proposed to construct six data center buildings totaling approximately 2.1 million square feet. Third-party data-center maps list the campus at 2840 Roxbury Road with 424 MW IT load.
notes: Capacity is from data-center tracker, while official DEQ/county records support project existence, permit review, and six-building/2.1M-sf description.

status_detail: Charles City County Community Development hosts Data Center Information files for RZ-01-2025/SUP-01-2025/SUP-02-2025. Planning Commission minutes describe a rezoning for 515.23 acres along CC Road and Charles City Road for a data center with proffered conditions and recommended approval in May 2025; Virginia Business later reported Diode Ventures withdrew plans for the 515-acre campus in August 2025 after opposition and site-readiness concerns.
notes: Status uses rejected bucket for a withdrawn/scrapped proposal; county materials show active application history, news reports withdrawal.

status_detail: Datacenters.com lists Lumos Networks' 1145 River Rd Data Center as a colocation facility at 1145 River Rd, Charlottesville, VA. ChannelVision directory also lists Lumos Networks at 1145 River Rd, Suite 14, Charlottesville with colocation/data-center services.
